name: Russell Hillard Loines
bio: Russell Hillard Loines (1874–1922) was an American poet and writer, born in Brooklyn, New York.

He studied at Columbia University, where he helped found the Columbia Literary Monthly, and at Harvard, and gave up the law for literature. A selection of his letters and poems was privately printed in 1927.

poems.title: On a Magazine Sonnet
poems.author: Russell Hillard Loines
poems.text:
“Scorn not the sonnet,” though its strength be sapped,
Nor say malignant its inventor blundered;
The corpse that here in fourteen lines is wrapped
Had otherwise been covered with a hundred.
